column1: # SOURCES.tsv — where each third-party input comes from, as a link
# `SHA256SUMS` says WHICH BYTES are the ones the reported numbers came from.
# This file says WHERE TO GET THEM. Together they are the whole external-input
#   17 columns are not used here on purpose: five fields, tab-separated.
#   file          canonical filename, as in SHA256SUMS
#   url           direct download URL, or '-' when none exists
#   bytes         exact byte count of the copy the numbers came from
#   licence       as published by the source, read on 2026-10-03
#   note          why, or how to use the URL
# Verified 2026-10-03 by requesting each URL and comparing what the server
# reported against `bytes`; the four strongest checks are named in `note`.
